Connor McDavid's has a historic 23-game point streak to open the 2026-27 NHL season! Relive the most spectacular goals, incredible assists and jaw-dropping highlights from the star Edmonton Oilers forward's incredible start to the season.
McDavid piled up 13 goals and 42 assists for 55 points during the streak, tying Wayne Gretzky (1988-89) for the fourth-longest season-opening point streak in NHL history!
